name: scroll-based-velocity
title: Scroll Based Velocity
description: Scrolling rows of content whose speed and direction follow the page scroll velocity.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ScrollVelocityContainer, ScrollVelocityRow } from '@/components/ui/scroll-based-velocity'
</script>

<template>
  <ScrollVelocityContainer class="text-4xl font-bold md:text-7xl">
    <ScrollVelocityRow :base-velocity="20" :direction="1">Velocity Scroll</ScrollVelocityRow>
    <ScrollVelocityRow :base-velocity="20" :direction="-1">Velocity Scroll</ScrollVelocityRow>
  </ScrollVelocityContainer>
</template>

examples.name: scroll-based-velocity-demo
examples.title: Text
examples.description: Scroll the page to speed the rows up or flip their direction.

slots.name: default
slots.description: One or more `ScrollVelocityRow`s, which share one scroll-velocity value.

props.name: baseVelocity
props.description: Base speed, as a percentage of the content width per second. Rows stay still when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: direction
props.description: `1` moves the content to the left, `-1` to the right. Scrolling up flips it.

props.name: scrollReactivity
props.description: Speed up (up to 6×) and flip direction with the page scroll velocity.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Content to repeat and scroll. Copies are added until the row is filled.
